preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code; distinguish supplied evidence from inference.

audience-prerequisites.instruction: Set the intended audience and prerequisites; explain required terms rather than replacing every technical word.

mechanism-and-gaps.instruction: Explain how the parts produce the result; identify missing links and verify them with relevant evidence before revising.

bounded-simplification.instruction: Use examples or analogies only with their relevant correspondence and limits; retain conditions and uncertainty.

transfer-check.instruction: Check the explanation with a new application or counterexample; distinguish a proposed test from demonstrated mastery.
